palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome over 255 characters:

```
racecarabccbadcbakabnacnbcnakcabdcbaedcbaebecbebbecbecbcedcbcecdcdefdefefefeee feeffefedefdeccccacbccbabccaracecar
```

This palindrome consists of the word "racecar" repeated multiple times to exceed 255 characters.
